# Known server test failures accepted by .github/scripts/check-test-summary.sh
# (release.yml and server-tests.yml). One exact test name per line, as it appears
# after "not ok <n> - " in the CI log. Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are
# ignored.
#
# Remove a line as soon as that test is fixed (CI warns when a listed test passes).
# Never add a line to hide a regression - only add a name confirmed from a CI run.
endpointAllowed: blocks private/internal when hosted, allows public https
